messages:
From: Sarah Mitchell <sarah@openlib.dev>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration / demo

Hey Camila,

We signed up for Redwood through the GitHub integration flow (we're the OpenLib team). A couple of questions before we book a session:
- Does Redwood support syncing repo metadata and webhooks for private repos?
- Any guidance on mapping GitHub org roles to Redwood scopes?

We'd love a short demo focused on integration and onboarding for an engineering audience. Are there slots next week (preferably US mornings)? Our engineer (CC'd once we confirm) would like to attend.

Thanks,
Sarah Mitchell
Head of Engineering, OpenLib
https://openlib.dev
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mitchell <sarah@openlib.dev>
Date: 2026-06-10T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration / demo

Hi Sarah — great to meet you and thanks for signing up!

Short answers up front: yes on private repo webhook support (we use token-based GitHub apps + optional deploy keys), and we can map GitHub org/teams to Redwood roles via SCIM or our role sync tooling depending on your setup. I can cover both in the demo.

I have these slots next week (US mornings PT):
- Tues 2026-06-11 09:00-09:30 PT
- Wed 2026-06-12 10:00-10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-06-13 08:30-09:00 PT

If you can confirm which works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (10-minute integration walkthrough + 10-minute Q&A). Also helpful: what GitHub plan are you on (Org vs Enterprise) and will you want SSO/SSO provisioning?

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
From: Sarah Mitchell <sarah@openlib.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration / demo

Thanks Camila — Wed 2026-06-12 10:00 PT works for us.

Quick answers: we're on GitHub Enterprise Cloud and will want SSO via SAML. Please include one of your engineers who can answer questions about token scopes and deploy keys; our lead infra engineer (alex@openlib.dev) will join.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

— Sarah

Attached is a short agenda and what to expect:

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mitchell <sarah@openlib.dev>, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-12T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: OpenLib / GitHub integration - follow-ups from demo

Thanks for joining the demo today — appreciate the great questions. A couple of notes I promised to share:
- For private repos we recommend a GitHub App with read-only repo scope plus webhook subscriptions (we avoid broad tokens for security).
- If you need deploy keys for CI access, we can generate scoped deploy keys per-repo.
- For SSO we have a SAML checklist; I'll send the sample metadata and SCIM mapping doc after this thread.

Link to GH issue you mentioned: https://github.com/openlib/repo/issues/412

If you'd like a technical follow-up (30-45m), I can schedule time next week.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Engineer, Redwood Inference
